About Avaru

A spice brand taking shape in Surkhet.

Avaru is being developed in Birendranagar with a simple purpose: to make useful masalas and spice blends for the foods Nepali kitchens already love to prepare and share.

Starting with a real kitchen task

Our first product in testing focuses on momo achar—not the momo filling, and not a ready-made sauce. Avaru Momo Achar Masala is a dry blend intended to be used while preparing tomato-and-timur dipping achar.

Listening before launching

The recipe, instructions, pack size, price, availability and launch date are still being finalised. Feedback from home cooks and conversations with retailers will help us make responsible decisions.

Where we are now

Testing in Birendranagar, Surkhet

We are focused on learning what works in real kitchens before making commercial promises.
